prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to move the test tube to scale.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: scale
What the inspection checks: Check whether there is an uncapped test tube on scale.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: In the foreground, a white electronic balance sits on a bench, its square weighing platform tilted toward the viewer and its blue-and-white control panel showing red digits ("419") on the display. On the platform rests a white plastic open-framed holder or rack with square cut-outs. Behind and partly inside the rack stands a slim cylindrical tube/bottle holding a teal-green liquid, uncapped at the top, upright. Grey and black cables run down the white wall at left, and a blue plug/connector lies on the bench below the balance. Further back, a dark object sits on a metal-topped table; at right, a blue vacuum-pump-like machine on wheels, tall grey equipment and a bright window are visible.
observations: An uncapped test tube containing teal-green liquid is visible on the electronic balance, confirming the test tube is on the scale and uncapped.

args.observations: An uncapped test tube containing teal-green liquid is visible on the electronic balance, confirming the test tube is on the scale and uncapped.
